defects.before: Replay printed APPROVED without replacing stale qa-final snapshot; changed application could fail Pages gate after replay approval.
defects.after: Controller snapshots before QA, rejects changed inventory or content, records exact approved snapshot and round/evidence link before terminal APPROVED.
defects.verification: Independent integration fixture proves old approval fails real deployment gate, corrected approval passes, deletion during review rejects.

limitations: Replay CLI worker invocations have not been run end-to-end; controller integration uses deterministic fixtures.
Three-minute worker timer is not a proven Windows descendant-process termination bound.
UI verified with minimal DOM stub and markup inspection, not full browser rendering.
GitHub Actions and Pages not executed remotely.
